hero.title: Strive Adds $169M Bitcoin in Its Biggest Buy in Four Months
hero.description: The Nasdaq-listed bitcoin treasury company, co-founded by Vivek Ramaswamy, paid roughly $169 million for 2,000 coins last week and now holds 29,462 BTC.

latest.title: DeFi Development Corp Adds $3 Million in Solana as SOL Buys Slow
latest.description: Nasdaq-listed DeFi Development Corp's latest SEC filing shows its Solana stash grew 1%, to about 2.56 million SOL and SOL equivalents—roughly half the prior week's gain and well below mid-September's pace.

latest.title: Crypto PAC announces support for 32 House candidates in US midterms
latest.description: Fairshake said it would financially back 32 House candidates who all voted in favor of the CLARITY market structure bill in 2025, as the legislation remains in limbo in the Senate.

latest.title: House Democrat targets candidate prediction market trades after opponent’s Kalshi penalty
latest.description: A new bill bans federal candidates from trading prediction market contracts related to their own elections and would result in a fine if violated.

latest.title: A Florida Woman Used Claude as a Diary. An Anthropic Employee Read It and Reported It to Police
latest.description: Investigators say a Bonita Springs woman's Claude "diary" tripped Anthropic's safety filters. A human review team sent it to police, and Anthropic's own terms allow exactly that.

latest.title: Lucid's Q3 deliveries fall 6.7% as EV maker cuts production to align with demand
latest.description: Lucid delivered 3,806 EVs and produced 2,954 vehicles during the third quarter. That compared with 4,078 deliveries on production of 3,891 vehicles a year earlier.

latest.title: 'We had a threat': Trump explains U.S. moving long-range bombers from UK
latest.description: The U.S. Air Force B-1 bombers removed from England have been used in strikes on Iran.

latest.title: FinCEN withdraws proposed crypto mixing rule over ‘legitimate activity’ concerns
latest.description: The bureau under the US Treasury said it was withdrawing two proposed rules on unhosted wallets and crypto mixers ”as part of the Trump Administration’s deregulatory agenda.”

latest.title: Why a 4chan Bitcoin Prophecy Says Today Is the End of Crypto Winter
latest.description: An anonymous 4chan user called Bitcoin's October 2025 peak to the day way back in 2023. Could they be right again?

latest.title: Brazilian stocks jump as Bolsonaro now seen as heavy favorite to win presidency
latest.description: The moves come after the first round results of Brazil's presidential election on Sunday. Bolsonaro will face incumbent Lula da Silva in a runoff on Oct. 25.

latest.title: Treasury Kills Crypto 'Unhosted Wallet' and Mixer Surveillance Rules
latest.description: FinCEN withdrew a 2020 proposal to track transactions with self-custodial crypto wallets and a 2023 plan to designate crypto mixing as a primary money laundering concern.

latest.title: SpaceX stock climbs to highest since June, returning Musk to trillionaire status
latest.description: SpaceX shares have bounced almost 60% off their low in early August, boosted by the company's AI business and Starship progress.

latest.title: Modern Treasury seeks US trust bank charter for digital asset custody
latest.description: The payments infrastructure company is seeking federal approval to offer stablecoin custody and related fiat services through a limited-purpose national trust bank.

latest.title: TNT Sports head Luis Silberwasser to depart Skydance as CBS Sports chief David Berson takes over combined global sports group
latest.description: TNT Sports chief Luis Silberwasser will be leaving a combined Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery company, sources tell CNBC.

latest.title: Advocacy group pushes back on banks’ lawsuit against OCC over charters
latest.description: CCI CEO Ji Hun Kim said that the organization “remains confident“ in the OCC’s approval of charters for crypto companies, despite a recent lawsuit and pushback from some lawmakers.

latest.description: The on-chain sleuth says he posed as a customer of a Chinese crime syndicate, fronting $349,700 and eating 5% on every order, to track Lazarus Group's Bybit loot in real time.
